messages:
maria.finance: Quick sync — new price sheet goes live tomorrow 06:00 PT. Need final exceptions list for legacy credits, partner discounts, and any regulatory holdouts. I want a single authoritative CSV by EOD today.

jonah.pm: Do we have the segmentation for the A/B cells? I can double-check overlap with the exemptions.

alex_revops: Linking current candidate list: https://drive.redwood/revops/rate-change-exemptions.csv (view-only). Columns: account_id, reason_code, contract_ref, expiry_date. Please add rows or comment.

maria.finance: thx alex. Jonah — A/B cells are: control (no price change), test1 (new rates), test2 (new rates + promo). We need to ensure billing pipeline tags control correctly before run.

tess_ops: Heads-up: billing cutover window is 06:00–07:00 PT. Any invoice generation jobs touching impacted accounts should be paused 05:45–07:15. Ops will gate the pipeline.

sanjay: Two questions: 1) For accounts in the legacy credits bucket, do we apply credits before or after the new rates? That changes invoice amounts in the A/B skew. 2) For A/B analytics, we'll need a reconciliation key to join event logs with invoices (account_id + billing_period).

maria.finance: Good call. Apply credits after rate calc so fiscal impact matches prior practice. Reconciliation key = account_id + billing_cycle_start.

alex_revops: I ran a quick query to surface potential edge cases — sharing snippet: ```sql
SELECT account_id, sum(unbilled_balance) as balance, contract_type
FROM accounts
WHERE contract_type IN ('legacy_credit','partner_discount')
AND status = 'active'
GROUP BY account_id, contract_type
ORDER BY balance DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

alex_revops: There are ~128 active accounts with legacy credits > $0.5k, flagged in the sheet. Two of them have custom ratelimits (nonstandard invoice cadence).

jonah.pm: For the two with odd cadence — do we need a manual invoice suppression rule? If they generate invoices during the pause window, they'll pick up mixed pricing.

tess_ops: Yes, suggest adding a temporary job config: `invoice.pause.accounts = [<ids>]` during 05:45–07:15. Ops can push the override; will need approvals from finance.

maria.finance: Approve temporary invoice.pause for the listed two accounts. Alex, add them to the sheet and mark as "manual-suppress".

alex_revops: Done — added rows and flagged. Also left a comment on the sheet about applying credits post-rate calc.

billing-bot: Reminder: export job run scheduled at 05:50 PT will include invoices generated up to 05:45. To exclude cutover activity, set `export.snapshot_time=05:45` in the run config.

sanjay: For A/B tracking — I'll produce a small eval harness that compares revenue and DESC-level delta for control vs test1/test2 over the first three billing cycles. Plan to push analytic dashboard tomorrow.

maria.finance: Action items: 1) Alex: final authoritative CSV in the sheet (include manual-suppress tag) — by 18:00 PT. 2) Tess/Ops: implement pause + export snapshot config — confirm in thread. 3) Sanjay: analytics harness + dashboard — initial pass tomorrow. 4) Jonah: verify A/B cell tagging and that billing tags propagate to invoice stream.

jonah.pm: I will run a dry-check today on the tagging pipeline and post results here.

tess_ops: Ops will deploy pause override and confirm in 15:00 sync. Will also coordinate runbook for rollback if invoices start failing.

maria.finance: Thanks all. If anyone spots a contract that must be grandfathered permanently (legal language), ping legal and add `legal-exempt` in the reason_code. We will not ship without that final CSV. :white_check_mark:

alex_revops: Added a final column `final_approved_by` — I'll prefill mine once Finance confirms.

billing-bot: Export snapshot config updated: `export.snapshot_time=05:45` (set by tess_ops).

maria.finance: Closing note: please do not DM approvals — keep them here so audit trail is clear. I'll review the final sheet at 18:15 PT and publish cutover memo.

jonah.pm: Acknowledged.

sanjay: Acknowledged — will ping if analytics uncovered any sample-size issues."
